label.explanation: postgres's data volume climbed past 90% (lines 89, 128) and then filled, so every write failed with "No space left on device" (lines 159, 173, 180). order-service's orders inserts fail as a direct result (lines 166, 169, 186); reads keep working, which is why only writes surface as api-gateway 500s (lines 160, 187, 196, 205, 220, 235, 251). The insert errors look like data problems but the data is fine; it is storage. Red herrings: line 66 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400); line 70 (a config reload that changed nothing).
